_doc: Outer Layer (the skin channel): 'the slide', a cool neutral daylight ground so every skin tone reads true; uv violet for ultraviolet and the spoken word, water for the barrier. Read by kits/cinema/film/page.mjs (tokens → --<name>, roles → --hud-<role>, fonts → @font-face, type → --font-<role>, safe, captionY, cssText) and by kits/cinema/sci/contrast.py. Hexes are the bible's (films/channels/skincare/bible.md §2). Not Lumevina (black, rose, gold), not Los Güeros (espresso, amber), not Claude coral, not the other three channels. Captions sit on a white card plate. Sizes are px at 1080×1920; the roles carry the same sizes in vmin (px / 10.8).
name: Outer Layer
promise: Skin biology, ingredients and routines, with the evidence on the screen.

scene._doc: 3D only. A soft key from top-left (the lamp over the slide), a cool fill, a thin rim on the cut face. Skin colours come from the section's melanin parameter, never from a token. Only UV dashes and water beads bloom (threshold 0.92); text never does. The canvas is transparent over the stage gradient.

highlight._doc: The word being spoken turns uv violet on the white card; words still to come are text-2, words said are ink.

type._doc: Display: Newsreader 500 at optical size 72 for titles and the end card. Text: Red Hat Text 600 for captions, 600 for labels. Numbers: Red Hat Mono 500 for the depth gauge, counters and honesty notes (tabular by design). Glyphs ▬ ◆ ◇ ● fall back to DejaVu Sans (the page's system-safe stack), never Inter.

sizes._doc: px at 1080×1920. Captions: at most 2 lines of at most 24 characters; 54 px is set so the widest 24-character row fits the plate's maximum width (0.72 × W = 778 px) without hud.js shrinking it (measured in Chromium with ep01's rows: see PRODUCTION.md). Labels: the pill is at least 0.035 × H = 67 px tall.

labels._doc: White pill, ink text, a coloured glyph so colour is never the only cue.

contrast._doc: What contrast.py checks besides the automatic pairs. grounds: the flat colours text can sit on. behind: what the plate, pills and badges can sit over (the deepest skin the section draws first, then the ground).

pairs.note: the lit word on the caption card
the gauge's live value on a card

motif.signature_shape: The depth gauge: a thin µm ruler at the frame's left edge, a water tick for the live depth, a fixed 'paper ≈ 100 µm' mark. Its avatar: three stacked bars of decreasing thickness (the layers). Outer Layer owns the stack of layers; the ring is Light Minute's and the pulse line Meanwhile, Inside's.
motif.honesty_badges: Red Hat Mono notes for every cheat: 'not to scale', 'scale ×N', 'time ×N', 'simplified', 'model', 'estimate', 'debated', 'illustration'.
motif.title_card: A band at y 250–470 over the hook's section: the three bars draw in on the signature beside OUTER LAYER, the question below in Newsreader.
motif.end_card: The hook's composition returns; a white card with 'Next layer: …' and a one-line true-fact footnote with its source. Held ≥ 1.5 s.
motif.recurring_segment: To scale: the gauge lifts to centre and the episode's subject fills in beside the paper mark.
motif.colour_rules: uv violet is ultraviolet and the spoken word; water is water and the barrier. Skin colours come only from skin. No black ground, rose, gold, amber or coral.
motif.sound: F major at 64.2857 BPM (a 16th is 7 frames); soft pad and a breathy reed; signature reed F5, C6, A5, 7 frames apart.
